---
name: Historical supply or lot evidence
about: Document a dated supply or manufacturing change with provenance
title: "[History] "
---

- Event date or range, date type, precision:
- Manufacturer, supplier, part number or SKU if documented:
- Source URL / document number / version / section:
- Directly observed facts (not inferred):
- Does the source establish component availability, qualification, actual substitution, or its cause? Which is unknown?
- Affected production date codes / revisions if documented (non-identifying only):
- Counterexamples or alternative explanations:
- Is the source a corporate-level report or part-specific evidence?

Only publish material you are authorized to share. A supply shortage or a part announcement alone does not establish a GPU BOM change.
